detect: (?m)^[0-9A-F]{4,} +(?:LOCAL HEADER #\d+|CENTRAL HEADER #\d+|END CENTRAL HEADER|Extract Zip Spec)
parser:
import re

def parse(lines):
    rx = re.compile(r"^(?P<off>[0-9A-Fa-f]+)?(?P<sp>\s+)(?P<name>\S(?:.*?\S)?)(?:\s{2,}(?P<rest>\S.*?))?\s*$")
    vx = re.compile(r"^(?P<v>[0-9A-Fa-f]+)?\s*(?:'(?P<d>.*)')?$")
    hx = re.compile(r"[A-Z][A-Z0-9 ]*?(?: #\d+)?")
    rows = []
    used = []
    rec = ""
    top = ""
    extra = ""
    for i, l in enumerate(lines):
        if not l.strip():
            continue
        m = rx.match(l)
        if not m:
            continue
        off = m.group('off') or ""
        name = m.group('name')
        rest = m.group('rest') or ""
        v = vx.match(rest)
        if rest and v and (v.group('v') or v.group('d') is not None):
            val = v.group('v') or ""
            dec = v.group('d') or ""
        else:
            val = rest
            dec = ""
        parent = ""
        if off and hx.fullmatch(name) and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9A-Fa-f]{8}", val):
            rec = name
            top = name
            extra = ""
        elif off and len(m.group('sp')) > 1:
            parent = extra or top
        elif not off:
            parent = top
        else:
            top = name
            extra = name if name.startswith("Extra ID") else ""
        rows.append({"Record": rec, "Offset": off, "Field": name, "Parent": parent, "Value": val, "Decoded": dec})
        used.append(i)
    return {"blocks": [{"name": "fields", "kind": "table", "lines": used, "records": rows}], "skip": []}
